attributes.name: Detect Good
attributes.powers: During your turn, discard this card to examine the top card of your location deck. If it is an ally or a blessing, and does not have the Corrupted trait, you may immediately encounter it.
attributes.recharge: After playing this card, if you do not have the Divine skill, banish it; otherwise, you may succeed at a Divine 6 check to recharge this card instead of discarding it.
